sections.title: Frame for pages other than home
sections.what: Shows the navigation bar, a main content area and the legal footer for every page except the home page, which is returned without the frame.

summary: Wraps most pages in the standard frame: a top navigation bar, the page body, and a footer with legal links.
purpose: Gives every page except the home page the same header, main area and footer.
why: The comment says the landing page brings its own header, so the shared frame is skipped there.
how: 1. Reads the current address path. 2. If the path is the home page, returns the page content alone. 3. Otherwise returns the navigation bar, the main content area, and a footer. The footer links to Terms, Privacy, Attributions and How AI is used, and states that the product is free to play, has no money involved, and is in beta for ages 18 and up.
inputs: The current page path and the page content (children).
outputs: A framed page for every route except home.
risks: The home check is an exact match to the root path, so any other path gets the frame. The footer contains product and age claims that the owner should check.
debug: If a page is missing the navigation bar or footer, check the path check. If a footer link leads nowhere, check that the matching routes exist.
